_comment: IEM Cologne Major 2026 — Stage 2 (Swiss, 16 teams), COMPLETE + seeding RESOLVED 2026-06-09. Rounds + winners read from the OFFICIAL Liquipedia page via api.php ('Intel Extreme Masters/2026/Cologne/Stage 2', action=parse wikitext) and independently cross-checked against the settled Kalshi KXCS2GAME match markets (every winner agrees; Kalshi listed no markets for two R2 matches — FUT-TYLOO and Astralis-9z — which are taken from Liquipedia alone). SEEDING: seeds 1-8 = the invited teams in ascending Valve Global Standings rank from the 2026_05_04 INVITATION snapshot (ValveSoftware/counter-strike_regional_standings: FUT #4, Spirit #5, Astralis #6, G2 #12, Legacy #14, paiN #17, Monte #18, 9z #19), per Liquipedia's stated rule; seeds 9-16 = the Stage-1 qualifiers by Stage-1 Swiss & Buchholz placement (the same order tests/test_stage2_seeding.py derives via the shipped chain). VALIDATION (the Budapest-gate method): a brute force over all 40320 candidate invited orders left this order as the unique one that (a) reproduces all 8 official R1 pairings under seed-i-vs-i+8, (b) makes the engine replay generate the official R2-R5 pairings exactly, (c) makes the shipped Stage-2->3 chain derive the confirmed official Stage-3 seeds 9-16, and (d) is ascending-VRS per the stated rule.
